publications.abstract: Here we report the ATLAS discovery of the transient ATLAS26jyd (AT2026ywa) in galaxy ESO186-G021 at magnitude m_o = 19.22 +/- 0.15. At a distance of 76.65 Mpc, the transient was discovered on MJD = 61265.91 (2026-08-13.91) with an absolute magnitude of M =-15.3 +/- 0.2. The last non-detection through forced photometry (to 5-sigma, unforced) was on MJD = 61259.93. Forced photometry indicates the transient is rising, with plausible sub-threshold detections from MJD 61259.93. Spectroscopic classification is encouraged.
